# llmtrim-stats-plugin — combined document

Live llmtrim savings dashboard inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: a settings dashboard plus a rotating carousel stats strip under the composer.

- Repository: https://github.com/Zenjibad/llmtrim-stats-plugin (public, MIT, topic `dsh-plugin`)
- Human docs: [README.md](README.md) (English) · [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) (中文)
- Agent guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Source: [src/index.ts](src/index.ts) (host) · [src/client/index.tsx](src/client/index.tsx) (client)

## What it does

Two UI seats backed by one 5s poller, showing llmtrim's live savings from the same `llmtrim status --json` command the CLI uses:

- **Settings → llmtrim Stats** (`settings.section`, id `llmtrim-stats`): KPI cards — **You paid, Would have cost, Saved today, Saved this week** plus tokens trimmed, requests, net saved re-priced at list rates — daemon health badge + version, per-model table (model / requests / saved % / USD), and the **carousel configuration** (mode + stat checkboxes).
- **Composer carousel** (`conversation.composer.dock`, id `llmtrim-carousel`): a configurable strip — **Rotating** cycles one selected stat every 4s (`Saved today → Saved total → You paid → Would have cost → Saved this week → Tokens trimmed → Requests → Input saved → Round-trip`); **Static** shows every selected stat at once, fixed (no rotation); renders nothing when data is missing.

## How it works

1. Host half resolves the `llmtrim` executable via the `subprocess` service (`resolveExecutable('llmtrim')`, PATHEXT finds the exe; fallback `LLMTRIM_BIN`, then the npm win32-x64 path).
2. Each `/llmtrim-stats/api` request spawns `llmtrim status --json` (stdout capped 512 KB, 15s grace) and reshapes the result into a clean snapshot: `daemon`, `totals` (requests, tokens trimmed, input/output before-after + saved %, cache read, added latency), `money` (saved / saved today / paid / would-have / saved-this-week (prorated) / turns), `cost` (saved / spend / net saved / round-trip %), `byModel`, `config` (`{mode, staticStats}` from the settings namespace), `meta.fetchedAt`.
3. Client bundle: one shared 5s `setInterval` poller → `fetch('/llmtrim-stats/api')` → fan-out to the dashboard and the carousel (a `setInterval` advancing an index over the filtered slide list). Config changes are written with `PUT /llmtrim-stats/config` and persisted via the host's `settings` service.
4. Failures return `{ok:false,error}` JSON; the UI shows an unavailable state with a Retry button and self-recovers on the next poll.

## Install (packaged, persists across restarts)

- `dsh plugin --profile web add ./llmtrim-stats-plugin` (local dir) or `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Zenjibad/llmtrim-stats-plugin` (or `git+https://github.com/Zenjibad/llmtrim-stats-plugin.git`); then restart DSH **and hard-refresh the browser tab** (`Ctrl+F5`).
- The package declares `dsh.bundle` (`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row) and `dsh.client` (`exports["./client"]` = the browser bundle, scanned by client-modules at boot). No cordis_define, no per-session re-install.
- **Hard refresh is required after install/update**: the DSH client HMR only hot-swaps already-loaded bundles and does not pull new bundles into an open tab.
- Remove: `dsh plugin --profile web rm llmtrim-stats-plugin` + restart DSH.

## Configuration

Carousel behaviour is configurable from the Settings page and persisted in the `llmtrim-stats` settings namespace (via `PUT /llmtrim-stats/config`):

| Setting | Values | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mode | `rotating` (default) / `static` | Rotating cycles one selected stat every 4 s; Static shows every selected stat at once, fixed (no rotation) |
| Stats | 9 checkboxes (all on) | Which stats appear: Saved today, Saved total, You paid, Would have cost, Saved this week, Tokens trimmed, Requests, Input saved, Round-trip |

**Saved this week** = this-week (Monday-start) input tokens ÷ lifetime input tokens × lifetime `money.saved_usd` (llmtrim's `by_period` rows carry tokens but no USD — daily `2026-08-19` keys by default — so the weekly figure is prorated from the daily keys).

Fixed constants in source:

| Knob | Location | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP routes | `src/index.ts` | `GET /llmtrim-stats/api`, `PUT /llmtrim-stats/config` |
| Executable resolution | `resolveLlmtrim` in `src/index.ts` | `subprocess.resolveExecutable('llmtrim')` → `LLMTRIM_BIN` → npm win32-x64 path |
| Poll interval | `POLL_MS` in `src/client/index.tsx` | 5 s |
| Carousel cadence | `CAROUSEL_MS` in `src/client/index.tsx` | 4 s |
| Settings seat | `src/client/index.tsx` | `settings.section` id `llmtrim-stats`, order 80 |
| Dock seat | `src/client/index.tsx` | `conversation.composer.dock` id `llmtrim-carousel`, order 15 |

## Key behaviors

- Host is a real Node module (`Date` works); external commands go through the `subprocess` service, never `node:child_process` directly.
- Pure pull from the CLI — no ledger parsing, no file watching, no events.
- Read-only: never writes to llmtrim's directory or ledger; no credentials read.
- The host route never throws non-JSON; every failure is `{ok:false,error}` JSON.
- Themed with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only; no hardcoded colors.

## Probed environment facts

- Packaged host plugins are real Node modules: `process.env`, `Date` available; the dynamic-plugin sandbox limits do NOT apply.
- `subprocess.resolveExecutable('llmtrim')` resolves via PATH + PATHEXT (`.COM;.EXE;.BAT;.CMD`), finding the `llmtrim.exe` on PATH (e.g. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\llmtrim\bin` or the npm win32-x64 bin).
- `llmtrim status --json` top-level keys: `daemon, reroute, last_request_ts, requests, input, output, cost, money, added_latency_ms, cache_read_tokens, approximate, by_model, by_period`. `money.source = 'breakdown_turns'`, `cost.source = 'compressions_live_prices'`.
- `webServer.register` route shape: `{kind:'exact'|'prefix', path, handler(req,res)}` (node:http semantics); duplicate (kind, path) throws; register inside `ctx.effect` and return the disposer.
- The client bundle is plain browser JS (ModuleLoader CJS factory): `fetch`, `setInterval`, `document` available; React from the module table (`external: react`).
- The client must export `inject = ['slots']` (service key); the package.json `dsh.client.inject` lists package names (informational edges).
- `settings.section` and `conversation.composer.dock` are list slots; fresh ids add seats beside the shipped ones (never reuse shipped ids).

## Testing

- Pre-restart: profile `package.json` `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles` both list `llmtrim-stats-plugin`; `lib/client.js` has the ModuleLoader wrapper; `lib/index.js` exports `name` + `apply`.
- Post-restart (after hard refresh): Settings → llmtrim Stats shows the dashboard (incl. the four money cards + carousel config); composer dock shows the carousel in the configured mode; `GET /llmtrim-stats/api` returns the JSON snapshot with real numbers; toggling Rotating/Static + stat checkboxes persists across restarts.
- Failure paths: `llmtrim` missing from PATH → unavailable state + Retry; daemon stopped → zeros + "daemon stopped" badge; route unreachable → carousel hides, dashboard shows unavailable.
- No automated test framework; the manual matrix above is the verification contract.

## Build

`pnpm install && pnpm build` → `lib/index.js` (host, node ESM) + `lib/client.js` (client, CJS ModuleLoader closure, bundle id = package name). See `tsdown.config.ts`.

## Repository layout

- `src/index.ts` — host half
- `src/client/index.tsx` — client bundle
- `cordis.patch.yml` — `dsh.bundle` patch
- `tsdown.config.ts` — build config
- `package.json` — `exports["./client"]`, `dsh.client`, `dsh.bundle`
- `AGENTS.md` — agent guide
- `README.md`, `README.zh.md` — bilingual docs
